items.title: The FBI Doubles Down on Easing ‘Bestiality’ Hiring Standards
items.summary: FBI director Kash Patel claimed to US senators that the removal of a bar on hiring people who had engaged in bestiality was aimed at protecting sexual assault survivors.

items.title: Bernie Sanders says if AI is coming for workers, it should bring a four-day workweek with it
items.summary: Bernie Sanders and Mark Takano want AI productivity gains to help deliver a 32-hour workweek without cuts to workers’ weekly pay or benefits.
